name: evidence-lane-plugin
description: Evidence Lane keeps long Codex projects grounded in their evidence, resumes the exact unfinished work, and leaves every important decision with the user.

interface.shortDescription: Keep long Codex projects grounded, resumable, and human-approved.
interface.longDescription: Evidence Lane helps people carry substantial Codex projects across tasks without losing what was decided, what is active, or what still needs human approval. It keeps the working folder, user-selected Project/PV root, Plan, evidence, memory, learning, history, and hidden installed runtime as separate identities, then reconnects them through one governed workflow. Each change remains traceable to its source and active Plan row. State Travel resumes the existing project instead of starting over. No proposal, rollback, Git delivery, or Project or Learning acceptance happens without the required human decision. The current 3.0.0 package exposes 91 native actions (30 read and 61 write), 26 governed skills with no separate command layer, and 11 lifecycle event classes with 44 ordered handlers. Its 18 project-sector lanes remain distinct from Learning, Canon, Project Memory, Project Universe, Sources, Instructions, receipts and sessions, connector brain, and Project Overlay. The internal ENV/UOP action plane and whole-plugin SDK choose and govern the right workflow without turning stored authority into passive documentation.
defaultPrompt: Open my Evidence Lane project, verify that it is ready, show the current safe human entrypoints, and route every registered first-class workflow through the installed SDK automatically.
Show the accepted project state, current Plan row, recent changes, and supporting evidence without changing anything.
Explain the current governed HIL, the exact next human decision, and what each choice would change.
